# Generated by tools/gen_skonester_121_building_cheats.py.
# CK3 1.21 scopes/commands verified against a fresh script_docs dump.
# Only active holding-owned districts are traversed; foreign trade posts are excluded.

# District scope: upgrade each existing chain once if the next tier is legal.
skonester_121_upgrade_district_buildings_effect = {
	every_district_building = {
		limit = { can_building_be_upgraded = yes }
		upgrade_this_building = yes
	}
}

# District scope: the province-level constructor accepts this exact district.
# The engine checks slots, district/building eligibility and inactive districts.
skonester_121_fill_district_buildings_effect = {
	save_scope_as = skonester_121_build_district
	district_province = {
		build_random_district_building = { district = scope:skonester_121_build_district }
		build_random_district_building = { district = scope:skonester_121_build_district }
		build_random_district_building = { district = scope:skonester_121_build_district }
	}
}

# Province scope. Existing public callers keep their original pass count.
skonester_121_upgrade_province_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_holding = yes }
		holding_district ?= {
			skonester_121_upgrade_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		duchy_capital_district ?= {
			skonester_121_upgrade_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		special_district ?= {
			skonester_121_upgrade_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		great_district ?= {
			skonester_121_upgrade_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		entrepot_district ?= {
			skonester_121_upgrade_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		every_built_regular_district = {
			skonester_121_upgrade_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

# Province scope: use current AI construction selection for free district slots,
# then fill the existing districts and upgrade their legal building chains.
skonester_121_build_province_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_holding = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_free_district_slot = yes }
			generate_building = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_free_district_slot = yes }
			generate_building = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_free_district_slot = yes }
			generate_building = yes
		}
		holding_district ?= {
			skonester_121_fill_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		duchy_capital_district ?= {
			skonester_121_fill_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		special_district ?= {
			skonester_121_fill_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		great_district ?= {
			skonester_121_fill_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		entrepot_district ?= {
			skonester_121_fill_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		every_built_regular_district = {
			skonester_121_fill_district_buildings_effect = yes
		}
		skonester_121_upgrade_province_buildings_effect = yes
	}
}
